adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the recurring-cancel path is now nested inside `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` (the filtered list of `_calendar` references). For each reference with a `credentialId`, it re-enters the recurring branch and builds `promises` over `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar)` (organizer’s creds), and for each `updBooking` it still uses `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`, i.e. only the first calendar reference per updated booking. This means the same set of deletes can run repeatedly once per calendar reference, and it does not iterate/delete for the other calendar references (e.g., other hosts) in each updated booking. The repeated Promise.all blocks are also redundant and error handling is coarse (a single rejection causes the awaited Promise.all to throw), so the behavior can be incorrect/incomplete for multi-reference recurring cancellations.
